posts.author: ron olson
posts.content_md: I wil be moving my studio (again) later this summer and I'm looking to find good homes for some of my laser power supply modules. I have a number of capacitor banks, HV charging units, water/water heat exchangers and control units that I don't wish to move (again). If anyone has access to a truck or van and can make the trip to Las Vegas to retrieve it - I'll help you load it and wave a tearful goodbye. To the best of my knowledge, everything still works - but no guarantees. The units are for YAG and Glass laser heads and I have a few of these I'd part with as well. First come first serve.
